title: Three Men and a Baby
tagline: Three bachelors. One baby. Zero clue.
about: Three party-loving bachelors suddenly have to look after a baby left on their doorstep.
cue: Serve dessert when the guys sing the baby to sleep.
faces: We deliver, all night, every night

Chilli dip.Left on the doorstep, with a note.How to make it300g peeled green prawns1 egg white1 tsp grated ginger1 spring onion, chopped1 pinch salt6 slices of white bread4 tbsp sesame seeds1 L vegetable oil for fryingsweet chilli sauce, to serveBlitz the prawns with the egg white, ginger, spring onion and salt.Spread on the bread and press in the sesame seeds.Cut into triangles.Fry in oil at 180°C until golden, then drain.Serve with sweet chilli sauce.Chips & SchmearDay-old bagels, baked crisp. Chive and lemon cream cheese.Yesterday's bagels, nothing wasted.How to make it3 day-old bagels2 tbsp olive oil250g cream cheese2 tbsp chopped chives1 lemon, zestedSlice the bagels into thin rounds and brush with oil.Bake at 180°C until crisp.Beat the cream cheese with chives and lemon zest.Serve the chips around the schmear.MainsSteak SandwichSeared sirloin, butter onions, horseradish mayo and Swiss on sourdough.The architect upstairs orders it every time.How to make it2 brown onions, sliced20g butter600g sirloin steak80g mayonnaise1 tbsp horseradish8 slices of sourdough4 slices of Swiss cheeseCook the onions in butter over low heat until soft and golden.Sear the steak hard, turning once, then rest and slice thin.Mix the mayonnaise with the horseradish.Toast the sourdough, spread with mayo, pile on steak and onions, top with Swiss and grill until melted.SweetsVanilla Bean CustardYolks, sugar and hot milk, stirred thick. Warm or cold."Soft stuff." Peter, on what babies eat.How to make it500ml milk1 vanilla bean, split4 egg yolks60g caster sugar2 tbsp cornflourHeat the milk with the vanilla bean until steaming.Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornflour in a bowl.Pour on the hot milk, then return to the pan and stir over low heat until thick.Serve warm, or chill with plastic pressed on the surface.DrinksShaken Vanilla MilkWhole milk, vanilla, honey, shaken on ice. Nutmeg.For the night shift. The phone is in the shower.How to make it160ml bourbon400ml cold full cream milk40ml sugar syrup1/2 tsp vanilla extract1 bag ice1 whole nutmeg, to grateShake the bourbon, milk, syrup and vanilla with ice until frothy.Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses.Grate nutmeg over the top.
